name: firstmate-readonly
description: Read durable First Mate workflow status and evidence from a local ShipMates session.

interface.shortDescription: Read local First Mate workflow progress and results.
interface.longDescription: A local, read-only view of First Mate's durable workflow status, design, plan, artifacts, and evidence. It cannot approve, launch, modify, clean, or publish work.
defaultPrompt: Ask First Mate for the current workflow status.
Show the current First Mate plan and the candidate artifacts.
